title:
This type represents a reconstruction model used within the ReliabilityRiskMl module.
The reconstruction model is typically used to detect anomalies, outliers, or other issues by
reconstructing the data and comparing it to the original values. It plays an important role in
identifying potential risks or unusual patterns in the dataset.

Reconstruction methods are common in anomaly detection, where the reconstruction error is used
as a measure of how well the model understands the data. High reconstruction error indicates
that the data does not fit well with the learned model, often signaling an anomaly.

`@beta` This feature is in beta and may be subject to change.
name: ReliabilityRiskMl.Reconstruction
